	LINKS = {
		["https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tienkhanh1/Chilli-Hub-Script/main/StealAnEggg"] = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tienkhanh1/Chilli-Hub-Script/main/StealAnEggg",

		["https://chillihub.pro/roblox-mcp/eggtop.js"] = "https://chillihub.pro/roblox-mcp/eggtop.js",
	},
	CLIPBOARD = {
		-- ["Nội dung gốc"] = "Nội dung mới",
	},
}

local function applyStringOverlay(rawStr)
	if not ENABLE_CUSTOM_OVERLAY or type(rawStr) ~= "string" or rawStr == "" then return rawStr end
	if OVERLAY_CONFIG.TEXT[rawStr] ~= nil then return tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.TEXT[rawStr]) end
	if OVERLAY_CONFIG.LINKS[rawStr] ~= nil then return tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.LINKS[rawStr]) end
	local out = rawStr
	for k, v in pairs(OVERLAY_CONFIG.TEXT) do
		if type(k) == "string" and k ~= "" and string.find(out, k, 1, true) then
			out = out:gsub(k:gsub("(%W)", "%%%1"), tostring(v))
		end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(OVERLAY_CONFIG.LINKS) do
		if type(k) == "string" and k ~= "" and string.find(out, k, 1, true) then
			out = out:gsub(k:gsub("(%W)", "%%%1"), tostring(v))
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function applyImageOverlay(rawImg)
	if not ENABLE_CUSTOM_OVERLAY or type(rawImg) ~= "string" or rawImg == "" then return rawImg end
	if OVERLAY_CONFIG.IMAGES[rawImg] ~= nil then return tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.IMAGES[rawImg]) end
	local digits = rawImg:match("(%d+)")
	if digits then
		if OVERLAY_CONFIG.IMAGES[digits] ~= nil then
			local rep = tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.IMAGES[digits])
			return rep:match("^rbx") and rep or ("rbxassetid://" .. rep)
		end
		local fullKey = "rbxassetid://" .. digits
		if OVERLAY_CONFIG.IMAGES[fullKey] ~= nil then
			local rep = tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.IMAGES[fullKey])
			return rep:match("^rbx") and rep or ("rbxassetid://" .. rep)
		end
	end
	return rawImg
end

local function applyClipboardOverlay(rawClip)
	if not ENABLE_CUSTOM_OVERLAY or type(rawClip) ~= "string" or rawClip == "" then return rawClip end
	if OVERLAY_CONFIG.CLIPBOARD[rawClip] ~= nil then return tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.CLIPBOARD[rawClip]) end
	if OVERLAY_CONFIG.LINKS[rawClip] ~= nil then return tostring(OVERLAY_CONFIG.LINKS[rawClip]) end
	return rawClip
end

local watched = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function hookGui(obj)
	if not obj or watched[obj] then return end
	watched[obj] = true
	if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
		if obj.Text ~= "" then obj.Text = applyStringOverlay(obj.Text) end
		obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
			local mapped = applyStringOverlay(obj.Text)
			if mapped ~= obj.Text then obj.Text = mapped end
		end)
	elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
		if obj.Image ~= "" then obj.Image = applyImageOverlay(obj.Image) end
		obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
			local mapped = applyImageOverlay(obj.Image)
			if mapped ~= obj.Image then obj.Image = mapped end
		end)
	end
end

local function watchRoot(root)
	if not root then return end
	pcall(function()
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do hookGui(d) end
		root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) task.defer(hookGui, d) end)
	end)
end

if gethui then pcall(function() watchRoot(gethui()) end) end
watchRoot(CoreGui)
if not PlayerGui and LocalPlayer then PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end
if PlayerGui then watchRoot(PlayerGui) end

local clipFn = setclipboard or toclipboard
if hookfunction and type(clipFn) == "function" then
	pcall(function()
		local oldClip
		oldClip = hookfunction(clipFn, function(txt, ...)
			if type(txt) == "string" then txt = applyClipboardOverlay(txt) end
			return oldClip(txt, ...)
		end)
	end)
end
